headline: Gwalior: High Court Strict on Poor Road Quality, Stays NHAI's ₹26 Crore Payment; Seeks Government's Reply on Liquor Shop Policy Along Highways
summary: The Gwalior High Court stayed a ₹26 crore payment by NHAI over poor road quality. It also sought a government reply within seven days on the liquor shop policy along highways.
why: The National Highways Authority of India builds and maintains national highways, and its contractor payments depend on quality compliance.
